_comment: APPROXIMATE no-fly / permit-required areas in Singapore, bundled as a static file.
OneMap publishes no Drone Query REST API, so these shapes were traced from the
CAAS published no-fly-zone map and are deliberately coarse. They are good enough
for a pre-flight hint and NOT good enough to fly on. Always confirm against
Two zone shapes are supported, both in plain WGS84 degrees:
circle  -> { lat, lng, radiusM }           used for the 5 km aerodrome rings
polygon -> [[lng, lat], ...] (GeoJSON order, ring must be closed)
